attempts.errorSummary:
Fixed 2 code-defects (quick-view-add-to-cart-btn testid missing, close button aria-label removed). E2E-004b now passes. 3 remaining failures are test-code bugs:

E2E-002: Test uses modal.getByRole('radio') which gets ALL radios (color+size). Clicks second radio expecting image change, but second radio is a SIZE swatch that doesn't affect the image. Fix: scope to color radiogroup.

E2E-003: Test's variation selection iterates all radios and clicks first non-disabled one (already-selected color swatch). Size remains unselected. ProductView's validateAndShowError() prevents add-to-cart, modal stays open. Fix: iterate through each radiogroup separately to select complete variation.

E2E-006: Test expects ATC button to be disabled before variation selection, but base ProductView validates on click (shows "Please select all your options above") rather than disabling the button. Fix: assert validation message appears on click instead of asserting disabled state.

bugs.issue: E2E-002: modal.getByRole('radio') gets both color AND size swatches. Clicking index 1 may hit a size swatch that doesn't change the gallery image.
bugs.fix: Use modal.getByRole('radiogroup', { name: /color/i }).getByRole('radio') to scope to color swatches only

bugs.issue: E2E-003: Variation selection loop uses modal.getByRole('radio') and clicks first non-disabled radio (already-selected color), never selects a size. validateAndShowError() prevents addToCart from being called.
bugs.fix: Iterate through each radiogroup separately: const radiogroups = await modal.getByRole('radiogroup').all(); for each group, click first non-disabled radio

bugs.issue: E2E-006: Expects ATC button to be disabled before variation selection, but base ProductView validates on click rather than disabling. Button is always enabled; validation shows 'Please select all your options above' message.
bugs.fix: Assert validation message appears after clicking ATC without complete selection, or assert that clicking ATC does not close the modal
